_note: Golden HITL baseline for the autopilot-demo AC-9 oracle. The checked-in values are static and are not regenerated by the auto run. Provenance is recorded as a first-class, asserted _provenance block (SR-I1/R5).

_schema.artifact_paths: the shared, repo-relative artifact-path set (specs, plans, gate artifacts) a HITL run produces; the auto run must produce a superset (auto-only artifacts — decision journal, friction retrospective — are allowed additions). Volatile fields (timestamps, session ids, durations, absolute temp paths) are excluded by construction.
_schema.gate_iteration_counts: per-gate, per-scope converged-run counts from the HITL run; the auto run's gate+scope counts must equal these.

_provenance.source: Derived from the autopilot-demo HITL artifact/gate-count contract (workflow-model Phase 6-9 + engineering-principles). The artifact-path set and per-gate converged-run counts are the contract a real HITL run of autopilot-demo reproduces.
_provenance.attestation: Hand-authored deterministic fixture, not a live HITL capture (SR-I1/R5, option a). It pins the artifact-path superset and gate-iteration counts the auto run must reproduce; volatile fields (timestamps, session ids, durations, absolute temp paths) are excluded by construction.
_provenance.regeneration: To replace with a real HITL capture (option b): run autopilot-demo to complete under flow=hitl, snapshot _shared_artifact_paths(host) + _gate_iteration_counts(state) into artifact_paths/gate_iteration_counts, and set method=real-hitl-capture with the run's commit and date.
